input.quote: A. Throughout the Term of this Agreement, M&I shall maintain at all times at its own cost and expense:
input.rationale: Section 14.1 contains a real insurance clause (CGL at $2,000,000 primary limits, fidelity $10,000,000, workers' compensation as mandated by the state, all-risk property, plus "A"-rated carriers, 30 days' notice of change/cancellation and certificates on request). However, it carries no professional liability (errors and omissions) and no cyber/privacy coverage, so it fails both fallback elements for a vendor that processes our data and Items. We therefore stay at the fallback level and add only those two coverages ($1,000,000 E&O; $2,000,000 cyber/privacy) as a new item in the 14.1(A) schedule, so the existing at-own-expense lead-in, notice and certificate mechanics in 14.1(B) apply unchanged. The preferred-level gaps (E&O $2M, cyber $5M) are noted but not pressed.

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.

proposal.summary: Add E&O ($1M) and cyber/privacy ($2M) coverage to the M&I insurance schedule in 14.1(A)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] M&I's insurance schedule omits professional liability and cyber coverage even though it processes our customer data, so we added the two coverages at our fallback limits (E&O USD 1M; cyber/privacy USD 2M). The existing certificate and notice mechanics in 14.1(B) apply to these policies without further change.

ops.text: Professional Liability (Errors and Omissions) Insurance in an amount not less than one million dollars ($1,000,000), and Cyber and Privacy Liability Insurance in an amount not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000).
